# Prepayment Privileges

Prepayment rules.

## Lump-sum limit

A lump sum of up to 15 percent of the original principal may be prepaid each year.

## Payment increase limit

The payment may be raised by up to 15 percent.

## Penalty on a fixed-rate mortgage

The penalty is the greater of three months of interest and the rate differential.

## Penalty on a variable-rate mortgage

The penalty is three months of interest.

## Unused privileges

Unused privileges do not carry forward.
